display_name: Bean & Brew - Inventory Items Below Reorder Point
query_text:
SELECT count(*) AS items_to_reorder
FROM __CATALOG__.__GOLD__.inventory_current_status
WHERE stock_status = 'REORDER NOW'

display_name: Bean & Brew - Store Traffic Drop vs Prior 4 Weeks
query_text:
WITH mx AS (SELECT max(business_date) AS d FROM __CATALOG__.__GOLD__.store_daily_performance),
s AS (
  SELECT p.store_id,
    avg(CASE WHEN p.business_date > mx.d - INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN p.transactions END) AS last_7d_avg,
    avg(CASE WHEN p.business_date <= mx.d - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND p.business_date > mx.d - INTERVAL 35 DAYS THEN p.transactions END) AS prior_28d_avg
  FROM __CATALOG__.__GOLD__.store_daily_performance p CROSS JOIN mx
  GROUP BY p.store_id)
SELECT round(min(last_7d_avg / prior_28d_avg - 1), 3) AS worst_traffic_change_pct,
       min_by(store_id, last_7d_avg / prior_28d_avg) AS worst_store_id
FROM s

display_name: Bean & Brew - Labor Cost % Above 30% Target
query_text:
WITH mx AS (SELECT max(business_date) AS d FROM __CATALOG__.__GOLD__.store_daily_performance),
s AS (
  SELECT p.store_id, sum(p.labor_cost) / sum(p.net_sales) AS labor_cost_pct
  FROM __CATALOG__.__GOLD__.store_daily_performance p CROSS JOIN mx
  WHERE p.business_date > mx.d - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  GROUP BY p.store_id)
SELECT count_if(labor_cost_pct > 0.30) AS stores_over_labor_target,
       round(max(labor_cost_pct), 4) AS max_labor_cost_pct
FROM s
